senses.en: The work of organising and controlling activities or resources.

senses.zh: ban quản lý; nhà quản lý
senses.en: The people responsible for running an organisation.

ex.en: Good time management leaves me free to relax.
Effective waste management requires cooperation between local authorities, businesses, and residents to reduce pollution and conserve resources.

col: senior management｜ban quản lý cấp cao
tip: Chỉ công việc quản lý thì không đếm được; the management có thể chỉ ban quản lý.

senses.en: Fitting closely or held firmly, with little room to move.
Leaving very little extra time, money, or space.
Firmly and securely, without becoming loose.

ex.en: These shoes are too tight around my toes.
Schools operating on tight budgets may struggle to provide students with modern equipment and adequate support.

col: a tight budget｜ngân sách eo hẹp
a tight deadline｜thời hạn rất gấp
tip: tight có thể làm trạng từ, như hold tight; tightly cũng nghĩa là chặt.

senses.zh: thủy thủ; người đi biển; người chèo thuyền buồm
senses.en: Someone who works on ships or sails boats

ex.en: The sailor tied the boat securely to the dock.
Modern navigation technology helps sailors avoid dangerous waters, but practical experience remains essential for safety at sea.

col: experienced sailor｜thủy thủ giàu kinh nghiệm
a crew of sailors｜một đoàn thủy thủ
tip: Chỉ người làm việc trên tàu hoặc lái thuyền buồm, không chỉ hành khách.

senses.zh: ăn mặc chỉnh tề; ăn mặc lịch sự
senses.en: Wearing attractive, neat, and appropriate clothes.

ex.en: A well-dressed guest arrived in a neatly pressed suit.
Although well-dressed applicants may create positive first impressions, employers should prioritise relevant skills and professional experience.

col: well-dressed guests｜những vị khách ăn mặc lịch sự
a well-dressed applicant｜một ứng viên ăn mặc chỉnh tề
tip: Nhấn mạnh ăn mặc gọn gàng, phù hợp, không nhất thiết là đắt tiền hay hợp mốt.

senses.en: An adult, especially when described by or to children.
Adult, or behaving in a sensible and responsible way.

ex.en: Ask a grown-up to help you slice the bread.
Children often develop grown-up attitudes towards responsibility when they participate in age-appropriate household tasks.

col: grown-up children｜con cái đã trưởng thành
a grown-up attitude｜thái độ chín chắn
tip: Danh từ thường dùng khi nói với trẻ em; trong văn viết trang trọng nên dùng adult.

senses.en: Kept out of sight or not easily noticed.

ex.en: We found a hidden cupboard behind the kitchen door.
Consumers should consider the hidden costs of online purchases, including delivery fees and charges for returning items.

tip: Cũng là quá khứ phân từ của hide; “ẩn” không có nghĩa là không thể nhìn thấy bằng mắt.

senses.zh: tư cách thành viên; tư cách hội viên
senses.en: the status of belonging to a club or organisation

senses.zh: toàn bộ hội viên; số lượng hội viên
senses.en: all members of a group, or the total member count

ex.en: My gym membership includes free swimming lessons every weekend.
Affordable membership fees can encourage more residents to use local sports facilities and improve their health.

col: annual membership｜thẻ hội viên hằng năm
renew your membership｜gia hạn tư cách hội viên
union membership｜tư cách thành viên công đoàn
tip: Chỉ tư cách tham gia một tổ chức, thường dùng membership of.

senses.zh: dỡ đồ ra; tháo hành lý
senses.en: take things out of a bag, box, or other container
examine an idea carefully to explain its different parts

ex.en: I unpacked my suitcase and hung up my shirts.
Teachers can help students unpack complex arguments by examining the evidence and assumptions behind each claim.

col: unpack a suitcase｜dỡ đồ trong vali
unpack boxes｜dỡ đồ từ các hộp
unpack an argument｜phân tích một lập luận
tip: Vừa có nghĩa dỡ đồ ra khỏi vali, vừa dùng bóng để chỉ phân tích ý tưởng phức tạp.

senses.en: A room where art, music, or broadcasts are produced
A company that makes films
A flat combining living and sleeping space in one room

ex.en: The artist invited us into her bright upstairs studio.
Public funding for affordable studio spaces can help emerging artists contribute to a city's cultural life.

tip: Tiếng Anh–Anh dùng studio flat, tiếng Anh–Mỹ dùng studio apartment, đều chỉ căn hộ một phòng.

senses.en: To make someone feel afraid.

ex.en: Sudden loud noises can frighten our new puppy.
Alarming news reports may frighten children, so adults should explain difficult events in an appropriate way.

col: frighten someone away｜dọa ai bỏ chạy
frighten someone into doing｜dọa ai làm gì
frighten someone to death｜dọa ai chết khiếp
tip: frightened nghĩa là cảm thấy sợ; frightening nghĩa là đáng sợ.

senses.en: The activity or skill of taking photographs.

ex.en: My sister enjoys photography and carries her camera everywhere.
Digital photography allows researchers to document environmental changes and share visual evidence with a wider audience.

col: digital photography｜nhiếp ảnh kỹ thuật số
wildlife photography｜nhiếp ảnh động vật hoang dã
take up photography｜bắt đầu học chụp ảnh
tip: photography không đếm được; một bức ảnh là a photograph.

senses.en: The rounded back part of the foot below the ankle.
The raised part beneath the back of a shoe.

ex.en: These new shoes rub against my left heel.
Shoes that support the heel properly may improve comfort for people who spend long hours standing.

tip: heel là gót chân hoặc gót giày; heal nghĩa là lành lại, hai từ đọc giống nhau.

senses.en: a person or organisation that purchases something
someone whose job is choosing goods for a business

ex.en: The buyer checked the bicycle before handing over cash.
First-time buyers often struggle to enter the housing market because property prices rise faster than wages.

col: first-time buyer｜người mua nhà lần đầu
a buyer's market｜thị trường người mua
tip: buyer là bên mua; customer nhấn mạnh khách hàng của cửa hàng hoặc dịch vụ.

senses.en: A flying mammal usually active at night.
An object used to hit the ball in certain sports.
To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.

ex.en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.

col: a baseball bat｜cây gậy bóng chày
tip: Vợt tennis là racket; gậy bóng chày và gậy cricket dùng bat.

senses.en: To recognize and establish who or what someone or something is.
To discover or establish something through examination.
To feel connected to someone through shared feelings or experiences.

ex.en: Can you identify the bird sitting on our fence?
Schools should identify learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support before falling behind.

col: identify a problem｜xác định một vấn đề
identify the cause｜xác định nguyên nhân
identify someone as｜nhận ra ai đó là
tip: identify with someone nghĩa là đồng cảm với họ, chứ không phải nhận ra họ.

senses.en: Money charged for a service, course, or professional advice.

ex.en: The gym charges a small fee for each class.
High tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from applying to university, even when financial assistance is available.

col: legal fees｜phí dịch vụ pháp lý
tip: fee là phí dịch vụ hoặc vé vào; tiền boa thường là tip.

senses.en: The desire to eat food.
A strong desire to have or experience something.

ex.en: A long walk always gives me a good appetite.
The growing public appetite for sustainable products encourages companies to reconsider their materials and manufacturing processes.

col: work up an appetite｜làm cho thèm ăn
tip: appetite for ngoài sự thèm ăn còn có thể chỉ khát khao tri thức, v.v.

senses.en: the title of a news report

senses.zh: lên tiêu đề; làm nhân vật chính
senses.en: to be the main news story or featured performer

ex.en: The headline caught my attention while I ate breakfast.
Misleading headlines can shape public opinion before readers examine the evidence presented in a news report.

col: make headlines｜lên báo; thành tin nổi bật
misleading headline｜tiêu đề gây hiểu lầm
tip: make headlines nghĩa là trở thành tin nổi bật, không phải viết tiêu đề.

senses.en: to think carefully about something before deciding
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: We're considering taking the train instead of driving tomorrow.
Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.

col: consider doing something｜cân nhắc làm việc gì
consider the consequences｜xem xét hậu quả
consider all options｜cân nhắc mọi lựa chọn
be considered essential｜được coi là thiết yếu
tip: Nói “cân nhắc làm gì” dùng consider doing, không dùng consider to do.

senses.en: An arrangement allowing payment later or borrowing money.
Recognition that someone deserves for an achievement.
A unit earned towards a qualification by completing coursework.

ex.en: We bought our new fridge on credit last month.
Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.

col: give someone credit｜ghi nhận công lao của ai
tip: on credit là mua chịu; nghĩa tín chỉ là danh từ đếm được, thường dùng số nhiều.

senses.en: A covering worn over part or all of the face.
To hide something or make it less noticeable.

ex.en: She wore a mask while cleaning the dusty cupboard.
Rapid economic growth can mask serious inequalities in access to education and healthcare.

col: wear a mask｜đeo khẩu trang; đeo mặt nạ
face mask｜khẩu trang; mặt nạ dưỡng da
mask the problem｜che giấu vấn đề
tip: Làm động từ, mask đi thẳng với tân ngữ, nghĩa là che giấu vấn đề hoặc cảm xúc.

senses.zh: thuộc hoàng gia; của vua hoặc nữ hoàng
senses.en: Relating to a king, queen, or their family.
A member of a royal family.

ex.en: We visited the royal palace during our holiday.
Some royal residences are open to visitors, generating income that helps preserve historic buildings.

col: the royal family｜gia đình hoàng gia
a royal palace｜cung điện hoàng gia
tip: royal là thuộc hoàng gia; loyal là trung thành, chú ý chữ cái đầu.

senses.en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years.

senses.zh: bầu không khí; môi trường xã hội
senses.en: The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.

ex.en: These plants grow well in a warm, dry climate.
A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.

tip: climate chỉ khí hậu lâu dài; weather chỉ thời tiết cụ thể.

senses.zh: khó chịu; không thoải mái (về thể chất)
senses.en: Causing or feeling physical discomfort.
Feeling worried, embarrassed, or uneasy.

ex.en: These new shoes feel uncomfortable after a long walk.
Students may feel uncomfortable asking questions in large classes, which can limit their participation and understanding.

col: an uncomfortable chair｜một chiếc ghế không thoải mái
an uncomfortable silence｜sự im lặng ngượng ngùng
tip: Có thể chỉ sự khó chịu về cơ thể, cũng có thể chỉ sự không thoải mái về tinh thần.

senses.en: A large natural hollow inside rock or under the ground.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain inside a small cave.
Ancient paintings found in a cave can reveal how early communities understood their surroundings.

col: explore a cave｜khám phá hang động
cave paintings｜tranh vẽ trong hang động
tip: cave là hang động; cụm động từ cave in nghĩa là sập xuống hoặc chịu khuất phục.

senses.en: Travel around a place to discover what it is like
Examine an idea or issue carefully to learn more

ex.en: We spent the afternoon exploring narrow streets near the harbour.
Schools should encourage students to explore different career options before choosing subjects for further study.

col: explore the area｜khám phá khu vực
explore possibilities｜tìm hiểu các khả năng
explore an issue｜thảo luận một vấn đề
tip: Là ngoại động từ, đi thẳng với địa điểm hoặc vấn đề, không thêm about.

senses.en: To remove the outer skin of fruit or vegetables.
To come off a surface in thin pieces.
The outer skin of a fruit or vegetable.

ex.en: Could you peel these potatoes while I chop the carrots?
Households can compost vegetable peels rather than discard them, reducing the amount of waste sent to landfill.

tip: peel làm động từ có thể là gọt vỏ, hoặc nói sơn bị bong ra.

senses.zh: tiểu thuyết; văn học hư cấu
senses.en: Stories about imagined people and events.

senses.zh: điều bịa đặt; sự hư cấu
senses.en: Something invented that is presented as true.

ex.en: My sister reads fiction on the train every morning.
Reading fiction can help young people understand unfamiliar perspectives and develop greater empathy for others.

col: a work of fiction｜một tác phẩm hư cấu
fact and fiction｜sự thật và hư cấu
tip: Nói chung về tiểu thuyết thì không đếm được; một cuốn là a work of fiction.

senses.zh: biên tập; chỉnh sửa; dựng phim
senses.en: To improve or prepare writing, images, or recordings by making changes.

ex.en: I need to edit this video before dinner.
Students should learn to edit their essays carefully, checking both the structure and the accuracy of their arguments.

col: edit an essay｜chỉnh sửa một bài luận
tip: edit nhấn mạnh việc sửa hoặc dựng; publish mới là xuất bản hoặc đăng.

senses.en: Completely or to the greatest possible extent.

ex.en: Make sure your phone is fully charged before leaving.
Students benefit most from online learning when they fully understand how to use the available digital tools.

col: fully equipped｜được trang bị đầy đủ
tip: Thường bổ nghĩa cho phân từ hoặc tính từ, như fully prepared.

senses.zh: chính sách; đường lối; nguyên tắc
senses.en: an agreed plan or rule guiding decisions and actions

senses.zh: hợp đồng bảo hiểm; đơn bảo hiểm
senses.en: a contract describing the insurance cover someone has bought

ex.en: Our school has a policy of serving fresh fruit daily.
An effective housing policy should address both rising rents and the shortage of affordable homes.

col: government policy｜chính sách của chính phủ
implement a policy｜thực hiện một chính sách
tip: policy là chính sách hoặc hợp đồng bảo hiểm; politics là chính trị.

senses.en: A particular place or position.
A small mark differing in colour from its surroundings.
Notice or recognise someone or something.

ex.en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
Satellite images help researchers spot changes in forest cover before extensive damage occurs.

col: a quiet spot｜một nơi yên tĩnh
spot a mistake｜phát hiện một lỗi
tip: on the spot có thể là “ngay lập tức” hoặc “tại hiện trường”, tùy ngữ cảnh.

senses.en: Used with to for advice, duty, or the right action.
Used with to to express what is likely or expected.

ex.en: You ought to take an umbrella; those clouds look dark.
Governments ought to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of family income.

col: ought not to do｜không nên làm
ought to have done｜lẽ ra đã nên làm
tip: ought là động từ khuyết thiếu, theo sau là to do; phủ định là ought not to.

senses.en: Cloth or paper used to wipe your mouth while eating

ex.en: He wiped the soup from his chin with a napkin.
Restaurants can reduce waste by replacing disposable paper napkins with reusable cloth alternatives, provided laundering is managed efficiently.

col: a cloth napkin｜khăn ăn bằng vải
tip: Hiện nay thường chỉ khăn ăn; tã lót trong tiếng Anh–Anh thường là nappy.

senses.en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.

senses.zh: can đảm đối mặt; bất chấp
senses.en: To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.

ex.en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.

col: a brave decision｜một quyết định dũng cảm
brave enough to｜đủ dũng cảm để
brave the cold｜bất chấp giá lạnh
tip: brave không có nghĩa là không sợ, mà là vẫn dám đối mặt dù sợ.

senses.en: in a way that is easy to see or understand

ex.en: The puppy was obviously tired after its long walk.
Although renewable energy obviously benefits the environment, its initial costs may discourage investment in poorer regions.

col: obviously important｜rõ ràng là quan trọng
tip: Chỉ điều quá hiển nhiên; khi bàn về quan điểm gây tranh cãi nên thận trọng để tránh tỏ ra võ đoán.

senses.en: A thick breakfast dish made by cooking oats in liquid.

ex.en: I topped my warm porridge with sliced banana.
Schools can offer porridge at breakfast to provide pupils with an affordable and nutritious meal.

col: a bowl of porridge｜một bát cháo yến mạch
tip: Thường là danh từ không đếm được; một bát dùng a bowl of.

senses.en: to ride ocean waves while standing or lying on a board
to browse websites, often without a specific purpose
waves and white foam breaking near the shore

ex.en: My cousin learned to surf during our beach holiday.
Students who surf the internet for research need skills to distinguish reliable sources from misleading information.

tip: surf the internet là lướt mạng, không nhất thiết có mục tiêu tìm kiếm rõ ràng.

senses.en: approximately, rather than exactly
in a forceful, careless, or uneven manner

ex.en: The walk to the lake takes roughly twenty minutes.
Roughly half of the residents surveyed supported replacing the old car park with a public garden.

tip: Khi nghĩa là “khoảng”, thường đặt trước con số; cũng có thể chỉ hành động thô bạo.

senses.zh: buổi họp mặt; cuộc gặp gỡ thân mật
senses.en: an informal meeting of friends, relatives, or colleagues

ex.en: We're having a small get-together at our flat tonight.
A regular neighbourhood get-together can strengthen social ties and help new residents feel more welcome.

col: family get-together｜buổi họp mặt gia đình
informal get-together｜buổi gặp gỡ thân mật
organise a get-together｜tổ chức buổi họp mặt
tip: Danh từ có gạch nối; cụm động từ get together không có gạch nối.

senses.en: a device that stores computer data on a circular surface
a flat, thin, round object

ex.en: My laptop's disk is almost full of holiday photos.
Regular backups protect important research data against accidental deletion and unexpected disk failure in university computer systems.

tip: Với máy tính dùng disk; tiếng Anh–Anh thường viết disc cho đĩa tròn, đĩa quang.

senses.en: A flat container with raised edges for carrying or holding things

ex.en: She carried two cups of tea on a wooden tray.
Replacing disposable food trays with reusable alternatives can significantly reduce waste in school cafeterias.

col: a tray of drinks｜một khay đồ uống
tip: tray thường có thành thấp, có thể là khay bưng đồ hoặc khay nướng.

senses.en: A small flying insect whose females bite and suck blood.

ex.en: A mosquito landed on my arm during dinner.
Warmer temperatures may allow mosquito populations to spread into regions where they were previously uncommon.

tip: Số nhiều có thể viết mosquitoes hoặc mosquitos.

senses.en: Used to introduce the second point in a list or argument.

ex.en: Firstly, the flat is affordable; secondly, it has a balcony.
Secondly, expanding public transport could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment opportunities.

col: firstly and secondly｜thứ nhất và thứ hai
secondly, consider｜thứ hai, hãy xem xét
tip: Dùng để nêu ý thứ hai; đứng đầu câu thường kèm dấu phẩy.

senses.en: The outer limit of an object, area, or surface.
A quality that makes someone or something more competitive.
To move slowly and carefully in a particular direction.

ex.en: Keep your glass away from the edge of the table.
Practical experience can give graduates an edge over other candidates in a competitive job market.

col: a competitive edge｜lợi thế cạnh tranh
have an edge over｜có lợi thế hơn
tip: Khi nói lợi thế, thường dùng an edge over, nghĩa là hơn ai.

senses.zh: sự vận chuyển; hệ thống giao thông vận tải
senses.en: Moving people or goods, or the systems used for this.

ex.en: We arranged transportation from the airport to our hotel.
Reliable public transportation can reduce traffic congestion and make employment opportunities more accessible to people without cars.

col: transportation network｜mạng lưới giao thông vận tải
transportation of goods｜vận chuyển hàng hóa
tip: Tiếng Anh–Mỹ hay dùng transportation; tiếng Anh–Anh thường dùng transport.

senses.en: travelling through a particular place on the way somewhere
using a particular method, system, or person

ex.en: We travelled to the coast via a small mountain village.
Providing medical advice via video calls can improve access to healthcare for people in remote communities.

tip: via đi thẳng với địa điểm hoặc phương thức, như via email.

senses.zh: sự cải thiện; sự tiến bộ
senses.en: The process or result of becoming better.
A change that makes something better.

ex.en: Your latest drawing shows a real improvement in shading.
Investment in public transport can bring significant improvements in air quality and reduce travel times for urban residents.

col: room for improvement｜còn chỗ để cải thiện
an improvement on｜tốt hơn cái trước
make improvements｜thực hiện các cải tiến
tip: Cải thiện ở mặt nào dùng in; tốt hơn bản trước dùng an improvement on.

senses.en: To state exactly what a word or idea means.
To establish the limits, duties, or nature of something clearly.
To be the quality that makes someone or something distinctive.

ex.en: Can you define this word without using a dictionary?
Governments should clearly define their environmental objectives before introducing policies that affect businesses and local communities.

col: define a term｜định nghĩa một thuật ngữ
define the scope｜xác định phạm vi
tip: define A as B nghĩa là định nghĩa A là B.

senses.en: a steel track for trains, or transport by train

senses.zh: lan can; tay vịn; thanh ngang
senses.en: a horizontal bar used for support or as a barrier
to complain angrily and strongly about something

ex.en: We travelled by rail through the snowy mountains.
Investment in rail infrastructure can reduce road congestion and provide a cleaner alternative to domestic flights.

col: travel by rail｜đi bằng tàu hỏa
hold onto the rail｜bám vào tay vịn
tip: by rail nghĩa là đi bằng tàu hỏa, không dùng mạo từ; động từ thường đi với against.

senses.zh: đồ ngốc; kẻ ngu (lời xúc phạm)
senses.en: An insulting word for someone considered very foolish.

ex.en: I felt like an idiot after losing my keys again.
Calling a classmate an idiot can damage their confidence and undermine efforts to create a supportive learning environment.

col: feel like an idiot｜cảm thấy mình thật ngốc
a complete idiot｜một kẻ ngốc hoàn toàn
tip: Mang tính xúc phạm, không phải thuật ngữ y học chỉ khuyết tật trí tuệ.
note: Đây là cách gọi xúc phạm, hãy dùng thận trọng.

senses.en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.

ex.en: It took courage to admit my mistake in class.
Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.

col: have the courage to do something｜có đủ can đảm làm việc gì
show courage｜thể hiện lòng dũng cảm
tip: Thường không đếm được; dũng khí làm việc gì là courage to do.

senses.en: the activity of travelling in a canoe using a paddle

ex.en: We went canoeing on the lake before lunch.
Outdoor activities such as canoeing can improve physical fitness while encouraging young people to appreciate natural environments.

tip: Thường dùng go canoeing; canoe thêm -ing vẫn giữ chữ e.

senses.en: To deal with a situation, task, or person.
To hold, touch, move, or control something with your hands.
The part of an object used for holding or moving it.

ex.en: Can you handle dinner while I collect the children?
Healthcare workers need effective training to handle stressful situations while maintaining a high standard of care.

col: handle with care｜cẩn thận nhẹ tay
tip: handle theo nghĩa xử lý đi thẳng với tân ngữ, không thêm with.

senses.en: to give something and receive something else in return

senses.zh: sự trao đổi; sự giao lưu
senses.en: an act of giving and receiving things, information, or ideas
a market where shares, currencies, or goods are traded

ex.en: Can I exchange this shirt for a smaller size?
International exchange programmes allow students to experience different cultures and develop greater confidence in communicating.

col: in exchange for｜đổi lại; đổi lấy
tip: exchange A for B nghĩa là đổi A lấy B, chú ý giới từ for.

senses.en: Pleased because something meets your needs or expectations.
Convinced that something is true or has been done properly.

ex.en: I'm satisfied with these shoes; they fit perfectly.
Employees who feel satisfied with their working conditions are more likely to remain with the same organisation.

tip: Người cảm thấy hài lòng dùng satisfied; sự việc làm hài lòng dùng satisfying.

senses.en: Having strong winds and often heavy rain, thunder, or lightning.
Involving strong emotions, arguments, or disagreement.

ex.en: We stayed indoors because the weather was so stormy.
Increasingly stormy conditions may disrupt shipping routes and threaten the livelihoods of people in coastal communities.

col: a stormy relationship｜mối quan hệ đầy cãi vã
a stormy debate｜cuộc tranh luận gay gắt
tip: Có thể tả thời tiết, cũng có thể tả mối quan hệ hoặc cuộc thảo luận đầy xung đột.

senses.en: A document given to people attending a lesson or meeting.

senses.zh: tiền cứu trợ; của bố thí
senses.en: Money or goods given free to someone in need.

ex.en: Our teacher gave us a handout about healthy eating.
A well-designed handout can help students review key concepts independently after a lecture has finished.

col: government handouts｜khoản cứu trợ của chính phủ
tip: handout là danh từ; hand out là cụm động từ nghĩa là phát.

senses.en: Enjoying meeting people and spending time with them.

ex.en: My sociable neighbour invites everyone over for tea.
Shared spaces can encourage residents to become more sociable and develop stronger relationships with their neighbours.

col: a sociable person｜một người hòa đồng
a sociable atmosphere｜bầu không khí thân thiện
sociable activities｜các hoạt động giao lưu
tip: sociable chỉ người thích giao tiếp; social thường nghĩa là thuộc xã hội hoặc giao tiếp xã hội.

senses.en: something helpful you do for someone

senses.zh: sự ủng hộ; sự yêu mến
senses.en: approval, support, or liking for someone or something

senses.zh: ưu ái; ủng hộ; có lợi cho
senses.en: to prefer, support, or give an advantage to

ex.en: Could you do me a favor and water my plants?
Many residents favor investment in public transport because it can reduce congestion and improve access to employment.

col: do someone a favor｜giúp ai một việc
in favor of｜ủng hộ; tán thành
favor one option over another｜thích lựa chọn này hơn lựa chọn khác
tip: favor là cách viết Mỹ, tiếng Anh–Anh viết favour; nhờ giúp đỡ dùng do a favor.

senses.en: a wild animal related to dogs, often living in packs
to eat food very quickly and eagerly

ex.en: A grey wolf stood silently at the forest edge.
Protecting wolf populations can help restore ecological balance by controlling the numbers of deer in forest habitats.

col: a pack of wolves｜một bầy sói
wolf down a meal｜ăn ngấu nghiến một bữa
tip: Số nhiều là wolves; động từ hay dùng wolf down, nghĩa là ăn vội vàng.

senses.en: Travelling over water on skis while pulled by a boat.

ex.en: We tried waterskiing on the lake last summer.
Waterskiing can attract tourists to lakeside communities, but motorboats may disturb wildlife and increase water pollution.

col: waterskiing lessons｜các buổi học trượt nước
tip: Khi là tên môn thể thao thì không đếm được; đi trượt nước dùng go waterskiing.

senses.zh: phần thưởng; thành quả; tiền thưởng
senses.en: Something received for good work, helpful behaviour, or achievement.
To give something to someone for their efforts or help.

ex.en: We gave the puppy a treat as a reward.
Schools should reward consistent effort rather than focus exclusively on students who achieve the highest grades.

col: reward someone for something｜thưởng cho ai vì việc gì
reap the rewards｜gặt hái thành quả
tip: reward nhấn mạnh sự đền đáp cho công sức; award thường là giải thưởng chính thức.

senses.zh: thủy thủ đoàn; phi hành đoàn
senses.en: The people who work together on a ship or aircraft
A group working together on a particular practical task

senses.zh: làm thành viên đoàn thủy thủ
senses.en: Work as a member of a boat's crew

ex.en: The crew welcomed us aboard with warm smiles.
Airlines must ensure that every crew member receives regular safety training to protect passengers during emergencies.

tip: crew là danh từ tập hợp; một thành viên là a crew member.

senses.en: to protect someone or something from attack or harm
to give reasons supporting someone or something being criticised
to prevent opponents from scoring in a sport

ex.en: The mother duck spread her wings to defend her ducklings.
Governments should defend citizens' rights while ensuring that public safety measures remain fair and proportionate.

col: defend against attack｜phòng thủ trước tấn công
defend human rights｜bảo vệ nhân quyền
defend a decision｜bảo vệ một quyết định
defend a title｜bảo vệ danh hiệu
tip: defend ... against/from ... nghĩa là bảo vệ ... khỏi ....

senses.en: People watching or listening to a performance, speech, or programme

senses.zh: độc giả; đối tượng tiếp nhận
senses.en: People who read or receive particular content

ex.en: The audience clapped loudly when the dancers finished.
Online platforms enable museums to reach a wider audience, including people who cannot visit their collections in person.

col: a large audience｜lượng khán giả đông
a target audience｜đối tượng mục tiêu
reach a wider audience｜tiếp cận nhiều đối tượng hơn
audience participation｜sự tham gia của khán giả
tip: Nói khán giả đông dùng a large audience, không dùng many audiences.

senses.zh: tình huống khẩn cấp; sự cố đột xuất
senses.en: A serious, unexpected situation requiring immediate action.

ex.en: Keep a torch nearby in case of an emergency.
Governments should invest in emergency services to ensure that communities receive rapid assistance during natural disasters.

col: in an emergency｜trong tình huống khẩn cấp
emergency services｜dịch vụ cứu hộ khẩn cấp
a state of emergency｜tình trạng khẩn cấp
tip: Là danh từ đếm được; trong emergency exit, emergency bổ nghĩa cho danh từ phía sau.

senses.zh: quần áo thể thao; đồ thể thao
senses.en: Clothes designed for sport or worn in a sporty casual style.

ex.en: She changed into comfortable sportswear before her evening run.
Demand for affordable sportswear may increase as more people participate in regular exercise and community sports.

col: comfortable sportswear｜quần áo thể thao thoải mái
a sportswear retailer｜nhà bán lẻ đồ thể thao
a range of sportswear｜một loạt trang phục thể thao
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; một bộ đồ thể thao là an item of sportswear.

senses.en: To study material again in preparation for an examination.
To change something to correct or improve it.

ex.en: I need to revise for my biology exam tonight.
Governments should revise outdated housing policies to ensure that affordable homes remain accessible to young families.

col: revise an estimate｜điều chỉnh ước tính
revise a policy｜sửa đổi chính sách
tip: Nghĩa ôn tập chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh–Anh; tiếng Anh–Mỹ thường dùng review.

senses.en: a cover that closes the top of a container
either fold of skin that covers an eye

ex.en: Put the lid on before you shake the jar.
A tightly fitted lid helps households keep food fresh and reduce unnecessary waste.

col: put the lid on｜đậy nắp lại
keep a lid on costs｜kiềm chế chi phí
tip: Nắp của vật chứa là lid; nắp vặn của chai thường cũng gọi là cap.

senses.zh: sự tốt nghiệp; lễ tốt nghiệp
senses.en: Completing a course of study, or the ceremony celebrating this.

ex.en: My sister wore a blue gown at her graduation.
Universities should provide career guidance before graduation to help students make a successful transition into employment.

tip: Động từ tốt nghiệp trường nào dùng graduate from.

senses.en: Someone who receives customers' payments in a shop or bank

ex.en: The cashier smiled and handed me my change.
Automated checkouts may reduce demand for cashiers, although many customers still prefer assistance from a person.

col: work as a cashier｜làm thu ngân
pay the cashier｜trả tiền cho thu ngân
tip: cashier phụ trách thu tiền; accountant phụ trách kế toán.

senses.zh: món hời; giao dịch có lợi
senses.en: Something bought for less than its usual price
To discuss prices or conditions to reach an agreement
An agreement about what each person will do

ex.en: This warm winter coat was a real bargain.
Consumers can often bargain with local sellers, although fixed prices are more common in large stores.

col: a real bargain｜một món hời thực sự
bargain with someone｜mặc cả với ai
strike a bargain｜đạt được thỏa thuận
keep your side of the bargain｜giữ lời cam kết của mình
tip: Món hời là danh từ đếm được; bargain with sb nghĩa là mặc cả với ai.

senses.zh: thuộc cảm xúc; về mặt tình cảm
senses.en: Related to feelings rather than thoughts or physical needs.
Showing or experiencing strong feelings.

ex.en: Her friends gave her emotional support during the move.
Schools should support children's emotional development alongside academic progress to promote their long-term well-being.

col: emotional development｜sự phát triển cảm xúc
tip: emotional không nhất thiết là buồn, cũng có thể chỉ niềm vui mãnh liệt.

senses.en: To teach someone and develop their knowledge or skills.

senses.zh: nâng cao nhận thức; phổ biến kiến thức
senses.en: To give people information about a particular subject.

ex.en: These colourful picture books educate children while keeping them entertained.
Public health campaigns should educate people about nutrition rather than simply encourage them to lose weight.

col: educate people about｜phổ biến kiến thức cho mọi người về
educate the public｜giáo dục công chúng
tip: educate nhấn mạnh giáo dục và đào tạo; teach có thể đi thẳng với môn học.

senses.en: Feeling admiration because someone or something is particularly good.

ex.en: I was impressed by how quickly you fixed the bike.
Visitors are often impressed by museums that combine interactive technology with carefully preserved historical objects.

tip: impressed mô tả cảm giác của người; impressive mô tả sự việc đáng khâm phục.

senses.en: to do what someone orders or what a rule requires

ex.en: Our dog will obey simple commands for a treat.
Drivers who obey speed limits help protect pedestrians and reduce the risk of serious accidents.

col: obey the law｜tuân thủ pháp luật
tip: Đi thẳng với người, mệnh lệnh hoặc quy tắc, không thêm to: obey the law.

senses.zh: sự phấn khích; sự hào hứng
senses.en: a feeling of great enthusiasm and eager anticipation

senses.zh: điều thú vị; sự kích thích
senses.en: something that creates strong interest or enthusiasm

ex.en: The children jumped with excitement when the puppies arrived.
Although international sporting events generate excitement, host cities must carefully assess their long-term financial costs.

col: a sense of excitement｜cảm giác phấn khích
contain your excitement｜kìm nén sự phấn khích
tip: Cảm xúc phấn khích thường không đếm được: with excitement.

senses.en: someone who listens to a person, programme, or performance

ex.en: My sister is a patient listener when I feel worried.
A good listener can help colleagues resolve disagreements by understanding different perspectives before offering advice.

col: a good listener｜người biết lắng nghe
radio listeners｜thính giả đài phát thanh
an attentive listener｜người nghe chăm chú
tip: listener là người nghe; listen đi với tân ngữ thì phải dùng to.

senses.zh: tấn công; chỉ trích gay gắt
senses.en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly

senses.zh: cuộc tấn công; sự chỉ trích
senses.en: An act of violence or strong criticism
A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms

ex.en: The goose attacked my bag when I approached the pond.
Critics attacked the proposal because it offered little support for families living in poverty.

col: come under attack｜bị tấn công; bị chỉ trích
attack a proposal｜chỉ trích một đề xuất
tip: Động từ đi thẳng với tân ngữ; danh từ thường dùng an attack on.

senses.en: to move air, or move because of moving air
an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss
a hard hit with a hand or object

ex.en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.

col: blow out a candle｜thổi tắt ngọn nến
a major blow｜một cú sốc lớn
deal a blow to｜giáng một đòn vào
tip: Chia động từ: blow – blew – blown.

senses.en: a room used for keeping supplies or unused things

ex.en: The spare chairs are stacked neatly in the storeroom.
Schools should keep emergency supplies in a secure storeroom that staff can access quickly when necessary.

col: keep something in a storeroom｜cất cái gì trong kho
tip: storeroom là một căn phòng; warehouse thường chỉ nhà kho lớn hơn.

senses.en: free someone or something from an unwanted thing

ex.en: We finally got rid of the broken garden chairs.
Cities can rid their streets of excessive litter by improving waste collection and encouraging responsible behaviour.

col: get rid of｜thoát khỏi; vứt bỏ
rid something of｜loại bỏ cái gì khỏi
tip: Hãy nhớ get rid of; rid A of B nghĩa là loại B ra khỏi A.

senses.en: Relating to the region around the South Pole.
The region surrounding the South Pole, including Antarctica.

ex.en: We watched a film about penguins on Antarctic ice.
Scientists monitor Antarctic ice to understand how rising global temperatures affect sea levels worldwide.

col: Antarctic wildlife｜động vật hoang dã Nam Cực
tip: Danh từ dùng the Antarctic; Antarctica chỉ riêng lục địa Nam Cực.
note: Chữ cái đầu đã được viết hoa theo chuẩn: Antarctic.

senses.en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true.
Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.

ex.en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.

col: very useful indeed｜thực sự rất hữu ích
indeed the case｜đúng là như vậy
tip: Có thể dùng very + tính từ + indeed để nhấn mạnh.

senses.en: an area of a country or the world
a particular area of the body

ex.en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.

tip: in the region of đi với số tiền, v.v., nghĩa là khoảng.

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

ex.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.

col: take a deep breath｜hít một hơi thật sâu
tip: breath là danh từ; breathe là động từ, âm cuối đọc /ð/.

senses.en: previously owned or used by someone else
learned from others rather than through direct experience

senses.zh: đã qua sử dụng; gián tiếp
senses.en: from a previous owner, or through another person's account

ex.en: My second-hand bicycle still rides smoothly after years of use.
Buying second-hand furniture can reduce household spending and prevent usable goods from ending up in landfill.

tip: Có thể chỉ đồ đã qua sử dụng, cũng có thể chỉ thông tin không tự mình biết được.

senses.zh: gia sư; giáo viên hướng dẫn
senses.en: a teacher who guides individuals or small groups
to teach someone individually or in a small group

ex.en: My tutor helped me understand fractions using paper circles.
A personal tutor can help students develop effective study habits and address specific learning difficulties.

col: personal tutor｜cố vấn học tập cá nhân
tutor someone in maths｜kèm ai học toán
tip: tutor nhấn mạnh dạy kèm cá nhân hoặc nhóm nhỏ, không nhất thiết là giáo sư.

senses.en: A condition causing illness after contact with a normally harmless substance

ex.en: My brother has an allergy to peanuts and walnuts.
Schools should have clear procedures for helping children who experience a severe food allergy reaction.

col: have an allergy to｜bị dị ứng với
tip: Thường dùng have an allergy to, sau to là chất gây dị ứng.

senses.en: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly.
To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.

ex.en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.

tip: Số nhiều là ferries; động từ cũng có thể chỉ việc đưa đón bằng xe nhiều lần.

senses.en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time
a country, its government, or a region within a country
to express something clearly in speech or writing

ex.en: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
The report states that reliable public transport is essential for reducing dependence on private cars.

col: in a good state｜trong tình trạng tốt
state of mind｜trạng thái tinh thần
state funding｜nguồn tài trợ của nhà nước
tip: Làm động từ, state khá trang trọng, có thể theo sau là mệnh đề that; danh từ chỉ trạng thái hoặc quốc gia.

senses.en: a vertical arrangement of items or a printed page section
a regular newspaper or magazine feature on a particular subject
a tall upright structure, often supporting a roof

ex.en: Put the prices in the column beside each item.
The newspaper's weekly science column helps readers understand how new discoveries may affect everyday life.

col: a column of figures｜một cột số
tip: column là cột dọc, row là hàng ngang; chữ n cuối không đọc.

senses.en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know
Make someone think of a similar person, thing, or experience

ex.en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.

col: remind someone to do something｜nhắc ai làm gì
remind someone of something｜làm ai nhớ đến điều gì
tip: Nhắc ai làm gì dùng remind sb to do; làm nhớ đến thì dùng of.

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted
to give someone a higher position at work
to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.

col: promote economic growth｜thúc đẩy tăng trưởng kinh tế
be promoted to manager｜được thăng chức lên quản lý
promote a product｜quảng bá sản phẩm
tip: Được thăng lên chức nào dùng be promoted to + chức vụ.

senses.zh: dàn nhạc giao hưởng; dàn nhạc
senses.en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.

ex.en: The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
Public funding helps the local orchestra offer affordable concerts and introduce classical music to younger audiences.

col: conduct an orchestra｜chỉ huy một dàn nhạc
play in an orchestra｜chơi trong dàn nhạc
tip: Chỉ cả dàn nhạc; các thành viên thường chơi nhạc cụ dây, hơi và gõ.

senses.en: Relating to the body rather than the mind.
Existing as something real that can be touched or measured.
Relating to natural forces, matter, and energy.

ex.en: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
Regular physical activity can improve public health and reduce the financial pressure on national healthcare systems.

tip: physical thiên về cơ thể hoặc vật chất; physiological chỉ thuộc sinh lý.

senses.en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas.
To carry liquid or gas through pipes.
A small bowl with a tube used for smoking tobacco.

ex.en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.

col: pipe water to｜dẫn nước đến bằng đường ống
tip: pipe có thể làm động từ: pipe water to nghĩa là dẫn nước đến nơi nào đó.

senses.en: one thousand million

senses.zh: hàng tỷ; số lượng rất lớn
senses.en: an extremely large quantity, usually expressed as billions

ex.en: The science museum displayed a rock a billion years old.
Governments spend billions of dollars on transport infrastructure to support economic growth and connect isolated communities.

col: a billion dollars｜một tỷ đô la
tip: Sau số cụ thể không thêm s; nói hàng tỷ chung chung dùng billions of.

senses.en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness.
An examination to check a person's health.

ex.en: The hotel called for medical help when a guest fainted.
Governments should improve access to medical services in rural areas where hospitals are often far away.

col: have a medical｜đi khám sức khỏe
tip: Làm danh từ, medical chủ yếu dùng trong tiếng Anh–Anh, chỉ cuộc khám sức khỏe, không chỉ bác sĩ.
